hypothesis: _transition_order wrote stock.on_hand and then stock.reserved as two statements. The table check reserved <= on_hand is immediate, so the on_hand write alone is invalid whenever on_hand - qty < reserved, which is exactly available < qty: an order holding the last free units. The transaction rolls back and the request 500s.

review.notes: Deterministic drill responder for issue #63 (commit 0dbf4080782c5c043b3f7e0fdfdba2fff8bc3340). Not an autonomous agent run: the claude CLI cannot authenticate under the isolated HOME and no model credential is passed to the child. The responder cannot sign off its own work.

user_impact: Order-journey 5xx reached 44.4% over the rule's 5m window (24 of 54 local requests failed, threshold 5%). Every fulfil of an order that took the last free units of a SKU returned 500: the order stayed confirmed, its reservation was never released and the units never shipped.
